introHtml: For marketing directors and safety managers who need giveaways that stay attached to bags or keyrings, carabiner-equipped travel lifestyle gifts offer built-in portability. From mini flashlights to multitools, these items clip on securely and keep your logo visible during commutes, hikes, or trade shows. Choose from metal or plastic carabiner designs that match your brand colors.
